items.description: Represent the Application Client consumer-integration gate explicitly in Station launch geometry.
items.affectedOutcome: station-app may launch only after client-conformance completes and the consumer-integration gate accepts public conformance evidence without a Station-private integration seam.
items.sequencing: Application Client client-conformance completes first; consumer-authority attestation then permits the consumer-integration gate to be satisfied before separately authorized station-app work begins.

relatedDiscovery.relationship: owns the future exact-bundle Station attestation; this completed Station item owns only the graph correction

items.rationale: The consumer-integration gate is pre-product validation. The acyclic order is client-conformance, consumer-integration-gate, then station-app. Requiring Station implementation evidence at the gate would make station-app depend on a gate that depends on station-app.
items.terminalPath: Land the retained direct client-conformance edge and the new consumer-integration-gate edge for station-app atomically in combined packet client-conformance-shaping-152-v1.

completionEvidence.details: The combined packet retains the pending direct conformance edge and atomically adds the pending pre-product consumer-integration-gate edge. Gate satisfaction requires public conformance evidence and consumer-authority attestation, not Station implementation evidence.

evidence.details: station-app directly names Application Client client-conformance but did not explicitly name consumer-integration-gate.
consumer-integration-gate depends on client-conformance and requires Operator Station and Watcher to validate the supported client before product integration continues.
The prompt keeps station-app planned until both client-conformance and the consumer-integration gate permit launch.

Application Client, Watcher, and Operator Station classified the gate as pre-product exact-revision consumer attestation after conformance; campaign accepted that classification for combined packet client-conformance-shaping-152-v1.
